title.original: Agent Data Protocol: Unifying Datasets for Diverse, Effective Fine-tuning of LLM Agents
title.zh: 代理数据协议：统一数据集以实现LLM代理的多样化、有效微调
title.en: Agent Data Protocol: Unifying Datasets for Diverse, Effective Fine-tuning of LLM Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: ADP 的通用轨迹表示和双向适配器消除逐数据集训练胶水，可作为多框架 Agent 数据交换层。
inclusion_reason.en: ADP's common trajectory representation and bidirectional adapters remove dataset-specific training glue as a multi-framework agent data interchange layer.

abstract.zh: Agent Data Protocol（ADP）以轻量中间表示统一浏览、编码、工具和软件工程数据，并把同一标准数据转换为多种 Agent 训练格式。
abstract.en: The Agent Data Protocol (ADP) is a lightweight intermediate representation that unifies browsing, coding, tool, and SWE datasets and converts them into multiple agent-training formats.

problem.zh: Agent 数据并非绝对不足，而是分散在不兼容的任务、工具、消息和轨迹模式中，每个数据集都需专门清洗与训练适配。
problem.en: Agent data is fragmented across incompatible task, tool, message, and trajectory schemas, requiring dataset-specific cleaning and training adapters.

approach.zh: ADP 定义足以表达多类 Agent 轨迹的简洁语言，编写输入转换器汇聚既有数据，再由统一导出器生成各训练框架格式。
approach.en: ADP defines a compact language expressive enough for diverse agent traces, ingests existing datasets through converters, and exports framework-specific training formats.

system_design.zh: 协议层规范任务、观察、工具、动作和消息；适配层完成数据集到 ADP 与 ADP 到框架的双向转换，验证器检查结构一致性。
system_design.en: The protocol specifies tasks, observations, tools, actions, and messages; adapters convert datasets into ADP and ADP into framework formats, with structural validation.

key_results.zh: 统一多套公开数据后进行 SFT，在编码、浏览、工具和研究基准上平均优于对应基座模型，并无需逐领域调优。
key_results.en: SFT over many unified public datasets improves over corresponding base models on coding, browsing, tool-use, and research benchmarks without domain-specific tuning.

limitations.zh: 统一模式可能丢失环境特有语义、时间信息和许可证约束；公开数据混合也需要去重、污染与质量权重审计。
limitations.en: A common schema may lose environment-specific semantics, timing, and license constraints, while mixed public data requires deduplication, contamination, and quality-weight audits.

metrics.name: Average performance gain over corresponding base models
